verdict.rationale: Sentry has a documented public REST API (v0) with an official OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec in getsentry/sentry-api-schema. Its API reference includes listing a project's issues and bulk-mutating them, which covers listing, querying and updating issues. Organization Tokens and token-based CLI auth are documented for authentication. The OpenAPI probe 404s only on docs.sentry.io paths, and the spec is published on GitHub, so this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an endpoint for fetching raw event payloads, documentation of token scope granularity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
